system.description:
You can surge the power of a Vehicle's shields through your direct data link at precisely the right moment to reduce the damage to the Vehicle from incoming enemy fire.

Prerequisites: Droid or Cyborg Hybrid, Trained in Mechanics

Effect: As a Reaction, when your Vehicle takes damage above its Shield Rating, after the Shield Rating is reduced you can reduce the amount of damage sustained by the Vehicle by an amount up to the remaining Shield Rating. However, the Shield Rating is immediately reduced by one point for every point of damage reduced.

Special: The Recharge Shields Action cannot be used on the Vehicle until a full round after the use of Shield Surge. You must have a Scomp Link or similar direct data link to the Vehicle to use this Feat.
